{{Quote|Wise ArrGack, see if that is not demon of a Squib, coming to give glory on the altar of the Angel of Taxations and Imports.|[[GrrKack]]|<ref name="Scavenger Hunt">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>}}
The '''Angel of Taxations and Imports''' was an entity in the religious cosmology of the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]]. Worshippers paid homage to the Angel by conducting sacrifices on an altar dedicated to it. Members of the Ugors' rival species, the [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]], were among the beings offered up in such ceremonies.<ref name="Scavenger Hunt" />
